records.title: What Should You Do When Two Donors Offer to Fund the Same Pilot?
records.summary: Navigating the Wonderful Problem of Dual Pilot Funding It’s a fantastic situation to be in. You’ve developed an innovative pilot project, poured your heart and soul into its design, and now, two generous donors are stepping forward, both eager to provide the funding.
